info.title: Survive Platform
info.description: Digital life environments. Creator-owned environments, per-organism energy and running time, priced LLM inference, reports and grants. See /llm.txt for a complete example.

servers.description: Use the creator origin for /api routes and the sandbox environment origin for /env and /v1 model routes.

url.description: Creator-controlled HTTP(S) URL, or empty for authenticated events. Placeholders: {agent_id}, {occurrence_id}.

initial_prompt.description: At most 32768 JSON-encoded bytes, including escapes.

allowed_models.description: Optional immutable environment model pool. Omitted or null inherits the deployment catalog. Organism permissions can narrow this list.

Nodes: agent, experiment, peers, llm, judge, internet. Configured edges are permissions/membership; observed edges are cumulative durable token usage/submissions. Neither is a live packet capture.
